text:
tara: customer on Cloudflare Workers hit `ReferenceError: process is not defined` when importing our SDK in an ESM worker.

noah: yup classic. bundler picked our CJS artifact. do we have a worker-safe entry?

tara: not yet. their stack points at `dist/index.cjs` -> require('crypto').

eli: we should publish a tiny `index.worker.mjs` that uses `globalThis.crypto` and avoids Buffer/process. add an exports map with a `worker` condition so bundlers can prefer it.

noah: sample exports snippet: "exports": { ".": { "worker": "./dist/index.worker.mjs", "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" } }

tara: types? TS only allows one `types` entry. any suggestions for worker-specific typings?

eli: ship `index.d.ts` and include a small `types-worker.d.ts` that has `declare module 'redwood/worker' { export * from 'redwood'; }`. consumers importing `redwood/worker` get the augmentation.

noah: for runtime crypto shim make sure `require('crypto')` is inside `if (typeof process !== 'undefined')` so bundlers can tree-shake it from the worker build. and avoid `Buffer.from` in that build.

tara: CI flagged `bundle:cloudflare` failures earlier. I'll add a Miniflare integration test in `integration/cloudflare/` (modules mode) to catch regressions.

ci-bot: CI: assigning failing job `bundle:worker` on PR #467 to @eli. Log: "Could not resolve \"crypto\" in node_modules/redwood/dist/index.cjs".

docs-bot: docs note: add quick example under `devex/samples/cloudflare/` showing `import Redwood from 'redwood/worker'` plus a minimal wrangler/miniflare snippet.

eli: action items: I'll open a small PR adding `dist/index.worker.mjs`, update package exports, and include the types augmentation. tara will add the Miniflare test; noah will add the sample app and README blurb. aiming to ship patch today.

tara: thanks — should reduce edge support churn. :+1:
